name: Vertex
about: Watches Vertex's payroll tax services; an outage stops payroll tax calculation in CMiC payroll.
details: Reads Vertex's status page and keeps only the payroll tax services (not Vertex's sales tax and e-invoicing products). CMiC payroll calls Vertex to calculate payroll taxes, so during an incident payroll runs that need tax calculation can fail or stall.
label: :receipt: *Vertex Status*
categories: Vertex Payroll Tax Q Series On-Demand
